title: System
slide_intent: Separate a featured event from unrelated programmes, because readers need to distinguish the main invitation from other available activities.
strategic_value: A stable division between image, title and programme list can let MoMA advertise varied content without losing institutional recognition.
demonstration: Four arrows label a poster diagram: Title, Image, Unrelated Programs and Logo. The right column stacks programme text above a vertical MoMA signature.
practical_value: Assign distinct areas to the featured image, its title and secondary listings before composing a new institutional poster.

content_islands.name: Heading
content_islands.spec: Place System centrally above the diagram.

content_islands.name: Main content column
content_islands.spec: Place the title and dates at the upper left of the diagram with the crossed image placeholder beneath.

content_islands.name: Institutional column
content_islands.spec: Stack the unrelated-programme text and vertical logo in the narrow right column.

content_islands.name: Annotation arrows
content_islands.spec: Place the four labels outside the diagram and point each arrow to its corresponding region.

ingredient.name: Institutional poster content regions
ingredient.role: Separate the featured event from secondary programmes while retaining museum recognition.
ingredient.application: Use the diagram to separate title, artwork, programme list and signature; compare MO06 for variations in placement.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2009 institutional identity. Pentagram distinguishes this system from individual exhibition identities; the diagram supplies no numeric grid dimensions.

reference_purposes.Application: The labeled diagram assigns four content roles to separate regions.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying account connects the layout system to a coherent institutional voice.
